deep.reconstruction:
Heading: 'Neue Theorie der Zerlegung der Cuben' (New theory of the decomposition of cubes). This is the descent for x^3+y^3+z^3=0, i.e. Fermat's Last Theorem for n=3, carried out in Z[eps] with eps a primitive cube root of unity.

(1) Start from a^3+b^3+c^3=0, with a,b,c implicitly pairwise coprime integers. Put p=a+b, q=a+c, r=b+c. Then s:=a+b+c=(p+q+r)/2. The identity s^3-a^3-b^3-c^3=3(a+b)(a+c)(b+c) gives s^3=3pqr, i.e. (p+q+r)^3=24pqr.

(2) p,q,r are pairwise coprime. [Implicit step, mine:] From s^3=3pqr we get 3|s, so 27|s^3 and hence 9|pqr. By coprimality exactly one of them, say p, carries the factor 9. Writing s=3t gives pqr=9t^3. Coprimality then forces p=9P^3, q=Q^3, r=R^3 (signs absorbed into the cubes) and t=PQR. Substituting into p+q+r=2s=6PQR gives 9P^3+Q^3+R^3=6PQR.

(3) Use x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz=(x+y+z)(x+eps y+eps^2 z)(x+eps^2 y+eps z) with x=2P, y=Q, z=R. The product (2P+eps Q+eps^2 R)(2P+eps^2 Q+eps R)(2P+Q+R) equals 8P^3+Q^3+R^3-6PQR, which is -P^3 by (2). Hence product + P^3 = 0.

(4) Name the factors A=2P+eps Q+eps^2 R, B=2P+eps^2 Q+eps R (the complex conjugate of A), and C=2P+Q+R (rational). Since 1+eps+eps^2=0, A+B+C=6P, and ABC=-P^3. Therefore -(A+B+C)^3=-216P^3=216ABC.

(5) This is the same shape as (1), now in Z[eps]. Gauss sets A=alpha^3, B=beta^3, C=gamma^3; this tacitly assumes A,B,C coprime and that unit factors can be absorbed. Then (alpha^3+beta^3+gamma^3)^3=(-6 alpha beta gamma)^3, and choosing the cube root (adjusting by a unit) gives alpha^3+beta^3+gamma^3+6 alpha beta gamma=0.

(6) By the identity on the last line of the page, (alpha+beta+gamma)^3+(alpha+beta eps+gamma eps^2)^3+(alpha+beta eps^2+gamma eps)^3 = 3(alpha^3+beta^3+gamma^3+6 alpha beta gamma) = 0. So there is a new solution of X^3+Y^3+Z^3=0 in Eisenstein integers. Its size is controlled by alpha^3 | A with |A|^2 roughly p, which is the descent step. The size comparison and the infinite-descent conclusion are not written here.

(7) The converse map is also recorded. Apply the same factorization with x=2alpha, y=-beta, z=-gamma: (2alpha-beta-gamma)(2alpha-beta eps-gamma eps^2)(2alpha-beta eps^2-gamma eps) = 8alpha^3-beta^3-gamma^3-6alpha beta gamma = 9alpha^3, using (5). This returns to the shape 9P^3+Q^3+R^3=6PQR.

Geometrically, the substitution (x,y,z) -> (x+y+z, x+eps y+eps^2 z, x+eps^2 y+eps z) maps the Hesse pencil x^3+y^3+z^3=3 lambda xyz into itself (lambda -> (lambda+2)/(lambda-1)); lambda=0 maps to lambda=-2, i.e. the +6xyz form. Taking cube roots of A,B,C is the 3-descent (3-isogeny).

(8) Fifth-power analogue (for n=5): (p+q-r)^5+(q+r-p)^5+(r+p-q)^5 = (p+q+r)^5 - 80pqr(p^2+q^2+r^2). A first attempt '=p^5+q^5+r^5' is struck out. So a^5+b^5+c^5=0 written in this form becomes (p+q+r)^5=80pqr(p^2+q^2+r^2). A struck-out line attempts a similar cubic expression in P,Q,R.

(9) Final line: the identity (x+eps y+eps^2 z)^3+(x+eps^2 y+eps z)^3+(x+y+z)^3 = 3x^3+3y^3+3z^3+18xyz, which justifies step (6). The next page uses it to study which m make (x+y+z)^3=mxyz map to itself (m=-216, m'=54).
errors: No algebraic errors: every identity on the page checks.
The implicit hypothesis that a,b,c are pairwise coprime is not stated. It is needed for 'p,q,r unter sich untheilbar'.
Writing p=9P^3, q=Q^3, r=R^3 is a WLOG choice of which sum carries the 9. The signs are absorbable since they are cubes.
Setting A=alpha^3, B=beta^3, C=gamma^3 tacitly assumes A,B,C pairwise coprime in Z[eps] and that unit factors (powers of eps) can be absorbed. This is not justified on the page.
Passing from (sum)^3=(-6 alpha beta gamma)^3 to alpha^3+beta^3+gamma^3+6alpha beta gamma=0 requires choosing among three cube roots (a unit adjustment). It is not addressed.
The descent inequality (the new solution is smaller and nontrivial) is not written on this page.

results.what: Substitution p=a+b, q=a+c, r=b+c turns a^3+b^3+c^3=0 into (p+q+r)^3=24pqr; coprimality gives p=9P^3, q=Q^3, r=R^3 and 9P^3+Q^3+R^3=6PQR
results.modern_name: Standard reduction in Euler-style proofs of Fermat's Last Theorem for n=3
results.usually_credited_to: Euler (Algebra, 1770) for the n=3 case; this substitution is classical

results.what: Factoring 8P^3+Q^3+R^3-6PQR over Z[eps], taking cube roots of the factors, and producing a new solution of X^3+Y^3+Z^3=0 via alpha^3+beta^3+gamma^3+6alpha beta gamma=0
results.modern_name: Descent proof of FLT n=3 in Eisenstein integers; 3-descent/isomorphism within the Hesse pencil
results.usually_credited_to: Euler (1770, incomplete); Gauss's Eisenstein-integer proof was published posthumously in Werke II (1863), under this very title

results.what: Inverse relation 9alpha^3=(2alpha-beta-gamma)(2alpha-beta eps-gamma eps^2)(2alpha-beta eps^2-gamma eps)
results.modern_name: Factorization x^3+y^3+z^3-3xyz over Q(eps) applied to the Hesse-pencil member
Symmetric-function reformulation of x^5+y^5+z^5=0 for FLT n=5
results.usually_credited_to: Similar reductions in Dirichlet and Legendre (1825) for n=5

results.modern_name: Sum of cubes of the discrete Fourier components (Hesse-pencil transformation)

deep.surprise_reason: This is Gauss's descent proof of FLT for exponent 3 in Z[eps]. A Nachlass piece with this exact title ('Neue Theorie der Zerlegung der Cuben') appears in Werke II (1863), so it is already known as his. The n=5 identity is a routine reformulation.

checkable.asserts: a^3+b^3+c^3=0 is equivalent to (p+q+r)^3=24pqr with p=a+b, q=a+c, r=b+c
The product of the three factors plus P^3 equals 9P^3+Q^3+R^3-6PQR, so it vanishes on the curve

checkable.sympy: P,Q,R=symbols('P Q R'); e=(-1+sqrt(3)*I)/2; A=2*P+e*Q+e**2*R; B=2*P+e**2*Q+e*R; C=2*P+Q+R; simplify(expand(A+B+C-6*P))==0
checkable.asserts: A+B+C=6P, which together with ABC=-P^3 gives -(A+B+C)^3=216ABC
Sum of cubes of the DFT components equals 3(x^3+y^3+z^3)+18xyz
The product equals 9alpha^3 minus (alpha^3+beta^3+gamma^3+6alpha beta gamma), hence 9alpha^3 on that curve
The fifth-power identity on the page
